text:
The failing test now passes, and so does every test file in tests/.

Cause: update_fee in app/routers/fees.py applied amount and product_amount changes but never touched balance_amount. After a charge change on an unpaid fee, the outstanding balance stayed at the old 125.00 instead of 175.

Fix: update_fee now records the old total (amount + product_amount) before applying the update. If amount or product_amount changed, the request didn't set balance_amount, and the fee isn't PAID, it shifts the balance by the change in total. The balance is floored at 0. An explicit balance_amount or a paid fee behaves as before.

- The target test test_updating_unpaid_fee_amount_keeps_outstanding_balance_in_sync passed.
- tests/ as a single target was rejected by the tool ("target is not a tests/ path or node id"), so I ran each file separately: test_requested_changes.py 13 passed, test_auth_login.py 4 passed, test_database_connections.py 7 passed, test_insights.py 3 passed, test_push_notifications.py 3 passed.
